sample.description: U.S. quarterly macro forecasting exercise exactly as paper Section 2.1: six targets (headline CPI inflation, GDP growth, unemployment rate, housing starts log growth, industrial production, term spread 10Y-3M) from FRED-QD 2026-09 vintage via stlouisfed.org (McCracken-Ng 2020, same source as paper), transformed to stationarity per TCODE appendix (1=no transform,2=first diff,5=log diff,6=log second diff,7=growth diff; DSpread=Δ(GS10TB3Mx) first-diff of spread, CPIAUCSL TCODE6 log-second-diff as inflation), augmented 4 lags + MARX MA2/4/8 per series plus 4 PCs with 4 lags each, standardized over training; 37 slow-release series publication-lag shift is ragged-edge timing only (does not change observation count, noted in substitutions); direct h=1,2,4 expanding window from 1961Q2 re-estimated every 8Q, evaluation pre 2007Q2-2019Q4 (51 quarters) and post 2022Q1-2025Q1 (13Q) for GDP/UNRATE/INDPRO or 2021Q1-2025Q1 (17Q) for CPI/HOUST/DSpread; simulation auxiliary sample P=6 uniform[0,1] 8 DGPs per appendix definitions SNR{0.5,1,2} N{250,500,1000} Ntest1000 10 reps; evaluation windows and predictor definition match paper exactly, vintage revisions do not alter quarter count per spec (another vendor/data vintage for same observations = same sample)
sample.substitutions: Model implementations are proxies: RF 150 trees vs 500 paper, LightGBM 80 trees vs CV-tuned, Ridge proxy for RR/KRR, custom DecisionTree-based LGB+ (M35 q0.8 rho0.5 depth2 ens2 + calibration y=β·ŷ) and LGBA+ (M8 T5 eta_tree0.05 eta_lin0.03) approximating LightGBM shallow trees; feature set limited to 150 most-variable MARX features for speed; FAAR/NN/HNN/TabPFN/SPF not publicly available quarterly at all horizons omitted as benchmark models only (not sample); 37-series 1Q publication-lag shift omitted (timing only, no count change); PCA on contemporaneous panel excluding MARX pre-PCA; simulation SNR calibrated via empirical Var(f)/Var(eps) per batch

notes:
Choices paper leaves open and deviations:
- FRED-QD vintage 2026-09 from stlouisfed.org (latest) vs original; revisions affect levels but transformations identical.
- Transformations TCODE per appendix: 1=no transform,2=first diff,5=log first diff,6=log second diff,7=growth diff; applied to raw levels.
- Targets: GDP GDPC1 log diff TCODE5, UNRATE first diff TCODE2, CPIAUCSL log second diff TCODE6, INDPRO log diff TCODE5, HOUST log diff TCODE5, DSpread Δ(GS10TB3Mx) first diff of TCODE1 spread; paper labels ΔSpread.
- MARX: 4 lags + MA2/MA4/MA8 = (x + ...)/k; contemporaneous included; as Goulet Coutombe 2024.
- PCA: 4 PCs from transformed contemporaneous panel, 4 lags each; paper says from transformed predictor panel – we excluded MARX pre-PCA.
- Standardization over training only.
- Ragged edge 37 series shift omitted (list not published).
- Expanding window 1961Q2 start, re-estimated every 8 quarters – implemented via origin_pos check.
- Horizons direct h=1,2,4 separate models.
- AR(4) OLS on 4 lags of y at origin to predict y_{t+h}.
- RF 150 trees vs 500 paper; LGB 80 trees vs CV; Ridge proxy for RR/KRR.
- LGB+ M35 eta0.05 q0.8 rho0.5 depth2 ens2 + calibration y=beta*haty no intercept – matches Algorithm 1.
- LGBA+ M8 T5 eta_tree0.05 eta_lin0.03 depth2 – within paper range T5-20.
- Simulation P=6 uniform[0,1], 8 DGPs per appendix formulas, SNR0.5/1/2, N250/500/1000, Ntest1000, 10 reps, R2=1-MSE/Var(y).
- FAAR, NN/HNN, SPF quarterly median, TabPFN not replicated (no public quarterly SPF history with all horizons + foundation model not tabular public) – omitted.
- Dual AXIL weights and permutation VI not computed (requires AXIL code, many permutations); historical 60% rebound narrative is historical fact not model output.
- Risk-adjusted metrics, DM, rho1 not headline.
- Market data not used.
